question: Did Prompt One actually meet its hard floors? Counted mechanically, not trusted.
headline: All 6 numeric floors MET and all 29 contracted artifacts PRESENT — but only once the artifact set is read as the UNION of two trees. Five of my own probes were wrong before they were right.

contract_source.anti_fork_clause: _USER-PROMPTS.md:10725 'Do not count trivial forks or renamed copies.'
contract_source.md_json_parity_clause: _USER-PROMPTS.md:7859 'The Markdown and JSON must describe the same option set.'

trees.union_evidence: 15-IMPLEMENTATION-PRECONDITIONS.md:127-132 'Two trees, one contract'; independently corroborated by 01-BLOCKER-REPRODUCTION.md:3-6 naming 02-BLOCKER-ROOT-CAUSE.md as living in platform-redesign-2026-07-19, and by direct os.path.isfile on all 5.

substance_check.question: materially distinct + executable, or renamed variants of a neighbour?
substance_check.mechanical_scan_coverage: 100% of population, not just the sample — 108/108 blueprints and 58/58 protocols
substance_check.metric: token-Jaccard nearest-neighbour over the semantic fields (blueprints: purp/task/contra/out/gates; protocols: problem/mech/distinct/route/tier), stopword-filtered, name field EXCLUDED so a rename cannot hide a clone

blueprints.closest_pair: BP-TST-06 'Fail-First Red-Proof Certification' ~ BP-IMP-04 'TDD Red-Proof Batch Implementation' at 0.243

detector_control_both_states.method: planted 3 synthetic mutants of a real donor record into the real corpus and re-ran the identical scan
detector_control_both_states.separation: planted forks score 0.93-1.00; real-corpus maximum is 0.243. ~4-6x separation.
detector_control_both_states.verdict: PASS — the 'zero clones' reading is a measurement, not a silent detector

blueprints: BP-SEC-04 Supply-Chain Alert Campaign with Fail-Closed Gate
seeded_sample.why: Every sampled card carries a `distinct` / `contra` field that NAMES its nearest siblings by id and states the differentiator — e.g. P06 'P26 swarm is loud, P22 brainwriting passes drafts around, P20 Delphi iterates estimates not idea lists'; P25 'it is a re-run with amnesia, not another round; P54 mirrors across vendors but both runs are live'. The anti-fork rule is enforced IN the artifact, per-record, not just asserted in a preamble.
seeded_sample.executability: executable-SHAPED but NOT executed — every sampled card carries typed out{}, gates, contra, deps, conflicts and a stopping rule. The artifacts self-declare this: 09-WORKFLOW-BLUEPRINT-LIBRARY.json has discovery_only=true and 12-COUNCIL-PROTOCOLS-AND-PRESETS.json has status='DISCOVERY - no protocol here has been executed'. Zero of the 166 items have an execution receipt.

extrapolation.claim: The 108 blueprints and 58 protocols contain no exact-duplicate, renamed-copy, or one-parameter trivial fork.
extrapolation.basis: the mechanical scan is exhaustive over the population (not a sample) and its control fires at 0.93-1.00 against a corpus maximum of 0.243
extrapolation.residual_UNVERIFIED: A DEEP semantic paraphrase — same mechanism, fully rewritten vocabulary — would score low on token-Jaccard and evade this metric. Settling experiment: embed all 166 records with a sentence-transformer and re-run the nearest-neighbour scan on cosine similarity; a pair that is far in Jaccard but near in embedding space is the evasion case. NOT RUN.
extrapolation.claim2: The items are executable-shaped but unexecuted.
extrapolation.confidence2: almost-certain (90-99%) — the artifacts assert it themselves via discovery_only/status fields and no receipt exists anywhere in either tree.

my_own_detector_failures.note: Every one produced a WRONG answer that survived until a second, independent probe disagreed. Recorded because the audit's credibility rests on the probes, not on the conclusion.

incidental_findings.claim: The pinned KNOWN BLOCKER 'F-B-02: 31 option IDs resolve to two unrelated meanings' has been REMEDIATED by re-prefix, leaving 2 stale references.
incidental_findings.evidence: 13-ARCHITECTURE-CANDIDATES.md now carries 38 distinct MECH-NN ids and only 2 bare M-NN strings, both inside 'adopt-after-M-16' (line 1159) and 'adopt-after-M-21' (line 1193). 07-OPTION-UNIVERSE.json id_namespace records the fix: 'sec-4 mechanisms, re-prefixed M-NN -> MECH-NN on 2026-08-07 (finding F-B-02). Re-prefix only, never renumbered: old M-NN == new MECH-NN.' The namespace collision surface is now 2 text references, not 31 ids.
incidental_findings.action: Update the pinned ground truth. Re-prefix the 2 stale 'adopt-after-M-NN' strings to MECH-NN. Do NOT re-plan around a 31-way collision that no longer exists.

incidental_findings.claim: The 7 doc-13 ids reported ABSENT from the universe (M-12/16/17/19/28/30/38) are absorbed-by-merge, not dangling.
incidental_findings.evidence: 07-OPTION-UNIVERSE.json id_namespace.absorbed_not_dangling: 'M-12, M-16, M-17, M-19, M-28, M-30, M-38, M-39 appear in options[].from[] and merges[].absorbed but have no option card: they are pre-dedup 07-OPTIONS-LM.md ids folded into a canonical option.' merges[] has 50 entries and the arithmetic reconciles: 283 final + 55 collapsed + 3 removed = 341 pre-dedup.

incidental_findings.claim: 07-OPTION-UNIVERSE.json's counts.per_family_final uses STALE single-letter family labels (E/F/G) for families whose option ids are EV/RT/PR.
incidental_findings.evidence: per_family_final keys read 'E - quality gates & evidence adjudication': 21, 'F - agent / model / tool routing': 15, 'G - provenance, dedup & claim representation': 17 — while the actual option ids in both MD and JSON are EV-NN (21), RT-NN (15), PR-NN (17). Counts match exactly, so this is a display-label drift, not a count error. Any consumer keying off the family label rather than the id prefix will fail to join.

incidental_findings.claim: 07-OPTION-UNIVERSE.md carries a hand-added paragraph that a regeneration will silently delete.
incidental_findings.evidence: 07-OPTION-UNIVERSE.json id_namespace.hand_added: 'Not emitted by _uni_build.py; a regeneration drops this key.' The MD says the same at its ID-NAMESPACE paragraph: '(This paragraph is hand-added and will be lost if _uni_build.py re-emits this file — fold it into the generator.)' The F-B-02 remediation record is therefore one regeneration away from being lost.

bottom_line_for_prompt_two: Prompt One's floors are not the risk. Every floor is exceeded (112%-178% of floor), MD and JSON agree exactly on all four paired artifacts, and 29/29 artifacts exist. The two real consumption hazards are (a) the artifact set is a UNION of two directories and a one-tree read under-counts by 5, and (b) all 166 blueprints/protocols are DISCOVERY-only with zero execution receipts, so 'exists' must not be read as 'works'.
